title: Disciplines
wikitext: Disciplines are an additional ability that classes gain to assist in combat. Rogues were the first to receive disciplines, in the form of poison disciplines. Rogue poisons are auto-granted between levels 1 and 20. Combat poisons can stack with each other, but only one utility poison can be active at a time. To open your discipline window press Alt+C. (Note: Buttons copied from the discipline window will disappear when you log. To make a permanent button, make a macro with the text "/disc discname", like "/disc defensive"). === Reuse Timer Reductions === For each level gained after a discipline has been unlocked that discipline's reuse timer will be reduced by a minute. For example, Evasive is gained by warriors at level 52 with a 3 minute duration and a 15 minute reuse timer. After eight levels, at level 60, the reuse timer is reduced to just 7 minutes. This means the level 60 warrior can spend up to 3 minutes under the effects evasive for every 4 minutes not. Permanent stances and rogue poison disciplines have a 5 second reuse timer unless otherwise noted. == Disciplines by Class == As of right now, only Rogue poison disciplines are on Legends.
